baseline_models.focus_anchor: The knowing verb at word 3 governs the open relative object and the exhaustive indefinite at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing as disclosure, calling as directed speech, and the maximally general knowable thing combine into an exhaustive audit: no called-to referent or act of appeal remains outside divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of an object makes divine knowing the enclosing epistemic act.
Directed vocal appeal supplies the activity and orientation being disclosed.
The general knowable and reportable object gives the audit unrestricted object scope.

changed_reading.before: God is aware that they invoke alternatives.
changed_reading.after: Every referent, content, and direction of their appeal is fully exposed to God, with no residual called thing outside the audit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The calling verb at word 5 is routed through the besides/below construction at word 7 and closed by the Mighty-Wise pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The besides/below term can picture a nearer or lower proxy that falls short of the end. Directed appeal therefore becomes a ranked mediation route, while irresistible power and right-seeing governance locate effective agency at its true terminus.

activation_trace.role: Calling supplies an appeal that can be routed toward an expected responder.
Nearness coupled with falling short of the goal turns the alternative into a deficient intermediary.
Unanswerable dominance supplies the effective power absent from the proxy route.
Knowledge that reaches the right result supplies sound direction and governance.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts God with other objects of worship.
changed_reading.after: It audits appeals routed through lower or nearer proxies that cannot reach the intended end, then identifies God as the unblocked power and sound governor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The calling root at word 5 also carries claim-making, while knowing and judging frame the sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: An invocation can function as an asserted right, affiliation, or standing for the called authority. Divine knowing marks each purported authority distinctly, and wisdom-as-judgment tests the claim rather than merely overhearing a call.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation turns invocation into an assertion of authority and belonging.
A distinguishing mark supplies classification of each asserted authority.
A reportable object gives each claim a purported referent that can be examined.
Adjudication supplies the forensic decision applied to the classified claim.

changed_reading.before: God hears or knows calls addressed to other beings.
changed_reading.after: God inventories and adjudicates the authority-status and affiliations asserted through those calls.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier association command is paired with an explicit absence of human knowledge. Against that, the focus places every purported thing under God's knowing, turning the sentence into an exposure of unequal epistemic standing: attributed co-agency lacks disclosed warrant on the human side.

activation_trace.role: The purported partner remains a knowable claim-object whose actual status can be tested.
Full disclosure is positively assigned to God in the focus.
Participation supplies the co-agency that others press the addressee to assign.
Rigid negation removes the claimed human epistemic state.
The undisclosed object of association creates the direct contrast with divine disclosure.

structural_cues: 29:8 places the object of association inside an explicit no-knowledge construction; 29:42 places the open object of invocation under God's knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies association, negated human knowledge, and comprehensive divine knowing; I infer that the asymmetry undercuts authorization for co-agency, while a live alternative is that 29:8 only regulates obedience rather than supplying a general epistemic test.

changed_reading.before: God knows the substitutes that people invoke.
changed_reading.after: The sentence exposes an authorization gap: humans assign co-agency to a purported thing they do not know, while God alone knows what status that thing actually has.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier passages specify what an alternative is expected to do: receive submissive service, dispose of provision, take charge, and give aid. They then deny ownership and viable protection. The focus's unrestricted called thing therefore becomes a whole class of attempted service providers with no controlling capacity.

activation_trace.role: Directed appeal is the request sent toward an expected provider or protector.
The deficient intermediary supplies the failed route through which help is sought.
Submissive service identifies the practical dependence attached to the alternatives.
Repeated otherness directly links the worshiped objects to the focus's proxy class.
Power of possession and disposal names the capacity explicitly denied to the alternatives.
Allocated provision identifies the concrete benefit for which dependence is routed.
Taking charge supplies the governing and protective function expected from a proxy.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the rescue function denied outside God.

structural_cues: 29:17 repeats the besides-God construction around worship and immediately tests it by ownership of provision.
29:22 repeats the construction and denies both a managing protector and an aider.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, absent disposal of provision, and absent protection or aid; I infer that invocation operationalizes a dependency contract, though an alternative is that these passages list separate errors rather than one service-provider mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The called alternatives are simply false worship objects.
changed_reading.after: They are attempted providers, governors, and rescuers; the focus sweeps every such proxy into an audit of control it does not possess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alternatives are acquired as a scaffold for mutual affection in present social life. The same collective later partitions into reciprocal denial and expulsion. Invocation can thus maintain an in-group contract, and divine knowing encompasses the relational function hidden behind the named object.

activation_trace.role: Claim and affiliation make calling a way of asserting group standing around an authority.
Distinguishing marks allow the social claim and its eventual reversal to be classified.
Deliberate acquisition supplies the collective construction of the alternative authority.
The other-than relation directly identifies this constructed authority with the focus's objects.
Affection supplies the social adhesive for maintaining the shared authority.
Partition into reciprocal parties turns former cohesion into mutual disavowal.
Expulsion under anger supplies the terminal reversal of the earlier bond.

structural_cues: 29:25 sequences acquisition, mutual affection, reciprocal denial, and reciprocal expulsion around the same alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a social bond and its reciprocal reversal; I infer that the invoked authority helps stabilize the bond, while the live alternative is that affection is merely a motive surrounding the objects rather than a function performed by invocation.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun points to a list of external idols or beings.
changed_reading.after: What God knows includes the social coalition built around those referents and the future reversal of the loyalties they organize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding comparison recasts acquired protectors as a self-built shelter. Its woven complexity does not equal load-bearing force. In the focus, the solidity branch of might and the secure-construction branch of wisdom now contrast real cohesion and sound order with a proxy architecture that is shelter only in name.

activation_trace.role: Otherness anchors the focus to the same class of acquired protectors in the comparison.
Cohesion and firmness supply the load-bearing contrast to the weak shelter.
Secure and finished construction supplies the contrast in ordered design.
Acquisition supplies both the human adoption of protectors and the spider's building act.
Taking charge names the load-bearing protective function assigned to the structure.
The weaving creature supplies a network that can look elaborate while remaining weak as refuge.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protective architecture under test.
Loss of force supplies the structure's inability to bear assigned dependence.
The unrealized disclosure at the comparison's close flows directly into God's knowing in the focus.

structural_cues: 29:41 immediately precedes the focus and shares both the besides construction and the knowing root.
The comparison aligns two acts of acquisition before evaluating the resulting house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired protectors, a weak shelter, and title branches of cohesion and secure order; I infer a structural contrast between the house and the divine titles, while the alternative is that the titles close the warning generally without extending the building analogy.

changed_reading.before: God knows which weak protectors they call.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a load test on a self-built dependency network: elaborate connection cannot substitute for firm power and sound governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence denies escape, then assigns seizure by each party's own fault through differentiated modes while denying misplaced treatment by God. Might is therefore enforceability rather than undirected force, and wisdom is fitted judgment. Knowing every called thing becomes operative jurisdiction over each dependency and its consequences.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the complete case knowledge on which enforcement proceeds.
Overcoming power supplies non-evasion of the resulting judgment.
Adjudication supplies the fitted decision rather than indiscriminate force.
Getting beyond a pursuer supplies the escape that the sequence explicitly closes.
Being taken to account for fault supplies enforceable consequence.
Fault supplies the individualized ground for each seizure.
A pelting wind supplies one distinct mode of consequence.
A terrifying cry supplies a second distinct mode of consequence.
Ground subsidence supplies a third fitted mode of consequence.
Fatal drowning supplies a fourth fitted mode of consequence.
Putting something outside its proper place defines the injustice denied to God and attributed to their own acts.

structural_cues: 29:39 closes attempted escape; 29:40 repeats a distributive pattern of distinct outcomes before denying divine misplacement or injustice.
The Mighty-Wise pair in 29:42 follows this differentiated enforcement sequence by two verses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-escape, fault-specific seizure, multiple outcomes, and denial of injustice; I infer that the title pair names enforceable and proportioned judgment, while the alternative is that the outcomes illustrate power without specifying why each mode fits.

changed_reading.before: Mighty and Wise are general praise after a statement of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They identify knowledge that can be enforced without evasion and judgment that differentiates cases rather than applying blind force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between a comparison ending in unrealized human knowing and a statement that constructed comparisons are grasped only by knowers. God's knowing secures the actual referents and relations; human reason must bind the displayed elements against ignorance. The focus is thus the epistemic hinge of the comparison, not an detachable omniscience formula.

activation_trace.role: Unrealized disclosure leaves the weak-house diagnosis unrecognized by its subjects.
Divine disclosure supplies the stable knowledge of what the comparison diagnoses.
Right-reaching knowledge supports an exact rather than decorative comparison.
The formally presented comparison identifies the discourse unit surrounding the focus.
Making a comparison visible supplies the act of externalizing its mechanism for readers.
Restraint from ignorance supplies the human work of holding the analogy's elements together.
Human knowers supply the receptive counterpart to divine knowledge in the focus.

structural_cues: The sequence is human non-knowing in 29:41, divine knowing in 29:42, then human grasp by knowers in 29:43.
29:42 repeats the knowing root while preserving the same called alternatives diagnosed by the comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three-part knowledge sequence and the explicit comparison language; I infer that 29:42 guarantees the comparison's referential diagnosis, while the alternative is that it merely interrupts the comparison with a general assertion before 29:43 resumes it.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a doctrinal closure appended to the spider comparison.
changed_reading.after: It is the comparison's epistemic hinge: God knows the real dependency map that disciplined human understanding is invited to reconstruct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questioning elicits verbal attribution of cosmic production and ordering to God, and provision is again placed under exhaustive divine knowledge. In danger, invocation is purified toward God; after rescue, partnership returns. What they call is therefore not a stable list generated by simple ignorance but a routing behavior that contradicts acknowledged causality and changes with pressure.

activation_trace.role: Directed appeal supplies the route whose destination changes across conditions.
Disclosure encompasses both the stated belief and the changing practical route.
Origination supplies the causal capacity verbally attributed to God.
Subduing and directing things to a purpose supplies acknowledged cosmic governance.
Spoken answer externalizes their explicit causal attribution.
Turning away from proper direction supplies the contradiction between admission and appeal.
Allocated provision adds everyday dependency to the acknowledged causal field.
Exhaustive disclosure repeats the focus's knowledge claim over provision and every thing.
Actual calling under danger reveals a temporary direct route to God.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies the crisis-state purification of the route.
Release from danger marks the transition point at which routing changes again.
Renewed association supplies the post-rescue reversal of exclusive invocation.

structural_cues: 29:61 moves from a question about creation and cosmic ordering to their spoken attribution and then asks how they are turned.
29:62 joins provision, every thing, and divine knowing; 29:65 sequences danger, exclusive invocation, rescue, and renewed association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit attribution, practical invocation under danger, and post-rescue association; I infer that pressure exposes perceived dependence and safety permits rerouting, while the alternative is temporary sincerity without disclosure of a deeper stable orientation.

changed_reading.before: They invoke other things because they fail to know who truly governs.
changed_reading.after: They can acknowledge the true causal governor yet reroute dependence by circumstance; God knows the contradiction and every state-change in the appeal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the closing titles are usually read as attributes, not as an itinerary. The exact pair also closes 29:26 after departure toward the Lord, so the mobility reading remains contextually anchored; downstream prose should present it as a secondary affordance of the pair, not as its lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Mighty-Wise pair at words 11-12 can be heard against its exact earlier pairing after a declared departure toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Invulnerable strength makes the destination capable of receiving transferred dependence.
Right-reaching wisdom makes the transfer purposeful rather than mere flight.
Movement from one dwelling sphere to another supplies the concrete relocation pattern.
Sovereign lordship supplies the destination of relocated allegiance.
The repeated title ties strength directly to the migration declaration.
The repeated title ties wise direction directly to the migration declaration.

changed_reading.before: The final titles merely seal a warning about alternatives.
changed_reading.after: The pair also names a viable destination for severing and relocating dependence away from called substitutes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cascading-fall branch is distant from the ordinary calling sense. The focus root, the immediately preceding weak shelter, and the contrasting firmness and secure-order branches keep the systems analogy anchored; downstream prose must mark it as an exploratory image, never as a translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The calling root at word 5 has a cascading-fall branch, while the final titles can contribute cohesion and secure construction.

activation_trace.role: One element falling after another supplies a cascade model for interdependent proxy failure.
Material cohesion supplies the opposite of propagating structural failure.
Secure ordering supplies the opposite of an unstable dependency chain.
The shelter supplies the system whose supports are expected to bear dependence.
Loss of force supplies the initiating weakness that can propagate through the system.

changed_reading.before: Their calls are discrete appeals to discrete objects.
changed_reading.after: Their called-upon network can be pictured as a cascading support failure in which one deficient dependency pulls another down.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar most directly names called referents, not their production history. Nearby fabrication and making vocabulary makes the process reading live while the focus's thing and claim branches keep it anchored; downstream prose should say that the invoked authority-status may be made, not that every referent is unreal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The general thing at word 9 and the claim branch of the calling root at word 5 allow attention to how an authority becomes a socially reportable object.

activation_trace.role: Assertion of affiliation or right supplies the repeated claim that grants authority-status.
A knowable and reportable object supplies the publicly stabilized result of the claim.
Invented speech supplies a fabrication process attached directly to worship beside God.
Falsehood diverted from truth supplies the distorted content of that process.
Making through action supplies the practical production layer known by God.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories fixed external objects that receive calls.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose the manufacture of authority-status through fabricated claims and repeated practice, all of which remains known to God.

strongest_changes: 29:41 turns called protectors into a self-built but non-load-bearing shelter, with the final titles contrasting cohesion and sound construction.
29:8 makes divine knowing expose the lack of human warrant for attributed partnership.
29:17, 29:22, and 29:25 reveal material, protective, and social contracts hidden inside invocation.
29:39-40 make might enforceable and wisdom differentiated rather than raw force.
29:61-65 show invocation as circumstance-sensitive rerouting despite acknowledged divine causality.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition changed the focus from a static inventory of false objects into an audit of dependency routes: epistemic claims, resource expectations, protective and social scaffolds, load-bearing weakness, fitted judgment, and pressure-driven switching all remain anchored in the focus's calling, besides, thing, knowing, and title constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: The claim-making branch of the calling root may be an illuminating secondary activation rather than an active sense in the focus.
The cohesion and secure-construction branches of the final titles fit the weak-house context but may be contextual analogies rather than intended title semantics.
Crisis-exclusive invocation may reveal perceived dependence only temporarily rather than a stable underlying orientation.
The manufactured-authority and cascade readings should remain exploratory and explicitly non-translational.
